headline: BI Names One Himbara Bank as Renminbi Clearing Bank, When Will It Operate?
summary: Bank Indonesia has named one of the Himbara state-owned banks as the renminbi clearing bank. The article asks when it will begin operating, citing strong domestic demand for the currency.
why: Clearing banks process currency payments, and renminbi clearing supports trade and investment settlement between Indonesia and China.
